_comment: Baseline Claude Code settings for the runner-agent container. model defaults to Haiku 4.5 for cost-controlled iteration; override at CLI with --model if you need Sonnet. NOTE: no permissions.defaultMode set — Claude Code 2.1 rejects bypassPermissions when the container runs as root, which Docker does by default. The agent's Read/Bash/Write operations inside /workspace are allowed under the default permission mode for cwd-scoped paths.
